data.exact_reserve_text: An overall improvement of GBP 3.1 million on prior years' provisions was experienced during the year. This is due to improvements of GBP 4.3 million on property reinsurance and GBP 0.3 million on marine reinsurance partially offset by a deterioration of GBP 1.5 million on casualty reinsurance.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2018 year of account reassumed via quota share
prior_year_events.impact_description: The 2020 amounts include the 2018 year of account which was reinsured into Syndicate 2121 on closure at 31 December 2021; the 2018 year liabilities were subsequently reassumed by Syndicate 6134 as part of the 2020 quota share agreement, affecting reserve balances.

named_events.loss_description: Syndicate 6134 was not impacted by Hurricane Ian as much as the host syndicate as the majority of losses were in classes that the syndicate does not reinsure.

The impact of the war in the Ukraine will take many years to fully understand and that uncertainty will live on for a while longer; multiple classes of business have been called upon to help restore order where needed.

named_events.event_name: Once in a generation winter storm (US)
named_events.loss_description: A "once in a generation" winter storm affecting 200 million people in the US closed the year.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2022 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 185.764m. During 2022 there was an overall favourable movement on prior years' reserves of GBP 3.1m (a release), driven by favourable development of GBP 4.3m in property and GBP 0.3m in marine partially offset by GBP 1.5m of adverse development in casualty. The movement appears to be driven by claims development across those classes; the statements also note reassumption of 2018 year liabilities into the 2020 quota share which impacts comparatives.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure (GBP 3.1m) was taken from the "Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding" note and treated as a gross movement as presented. A gross claims development triangle is available (page 43) and notes that 2020 amounts include the 2018 year of account which was reinsured into 2121 on closure and later reassumed by 6134; this reassumption can distort development patterns. No explicit gross PYD by individual underwriting year was provided beyond the class-level narrative.
